description: Sorcerer/Monk spontaneous casting, Monk actions, component progression and persistence in the real engine on BG2EE/ToB including campaign-legal high levels.
prerequisites: Disposable legal fixture with Sorcerer/Monk, its shared GUI handler and the read-only checkpoint helper.
Legally created human lawful Sorcerer/Monk, local saves and real combat/rest/area transition access.
Installed-data progression oracle with separate Sorcerer and Monk levels; Monk component level determines fists.
XP grants may prepare low/middle/high progression but advancement occurs through the actual level-up screens.
Before preparation, hash and read installed XPCAP and XPLEVEL rows; derive attainable levels from those resources. Controlled XP may reach the installed cap but must not change or bypass it.

Real BG2EE data with ToB available for high-level preparation; record the active campaign and preserve legally created actors. Low/middle checkpoints may resume genuine campaign-start or imported lower-level saves; never overwrite component/class levels.
instructions: Learn spontaneous spells and cast through the real spellbook/action bar; use Search, Stealth and Monk abilities against real targets.
Attempt representative allowed and prohibited equipment; observe actual equipped slots and item restrictions.
At each low/middle/high checkpoint compare both component levels, fists, APR, AC, proficiencies, skills, HP and saves with the installed-data oracle; include unequal component levels.
Verify identity, known spells and available casting after ordinary rest, inn rental, area transition and save/reload.

Exercise actual inn room selection and rental confirmation for sorcerer-monk.rest.inn; derive restored spell charges and any pool reset from installed rules. Temple healing is a separate store purchase, not rest: record native cure identity/effects, expected HP healing and unchanged known spells in sorcerer-monk.temple-healing. Capture before/after values and native store UI actions; never invoke the store callbacks directly.
Run sorcerer-monk-tob-hla separately on a real ToB-capable fixture for the mandatory ToB HLA gate. Quit normally.
